claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting explicit discourse relations, with a macro F1-score exceeding 90%.
The model performs best on the contingency relation, with a performance improvement of 1.42% noted.
The model struggles with implicit discourse relations, achieving a macro-average F1-score of only 48.82%.
The CRF layer is not suitable for binary classification, indicating limitations in certain discourse relation types.
